name: family-drawer

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the open share sheet with both action rows, the description and Cancel in full.

tagline: A rounded sheet rises from the bottom edge with share actions.
summary: A bottom-anchored drawer that opens from a Share button with a title, description and large action rows. Choosing an action swaps the sheet to a second view, such as a copied-link confirmation, and resizes to fit.
appearance: A narrow dark sheet rises from the bottom of a dimmed page with large rounded corners. It holds a small icon, a bold title, a grey description, two full-width muted rows with icons, and a plain Cancel line; an X sits at the top right.
behaviour: The Share button slides the sheet up from the bottom. Choosing Copy link or Send via email fades and scales the content into a new view while the sheet's height animates to fit; Cancel or the overlay closes it.
demo_content: Share this item, with Copy link and Send via email; a copied view shows myapp.com/share/abc123.
search_phrases: drawer that slides up from the bottom
small modal with copy link and email
sheet that changes size between views
use_when: A few share or action choices should appear from the bottom edge without leaving the page.
avoid_when: The drawer is capped at 361px wide and a few short views, so dense forms or wide tables do not fit.
customise: Root takes views, open, defaultView and change callbacks; each view is built from the exported header, button and wrapper parts. Colours follow theme tokens.
weight_why: A measured bottom sheet with view transitions; light, but it pulls several dependencies.

a11y.note: The icon-only close button has no aria-label, and the view swaps are not announced to screen readers.

issues: The icon-only close button has no accessible name beyond its inner SVG title.
The sheet is capped at 361px, so on wide screens it stays a narrow phone-style panel.
polish_why: Crisp iOS-like sheet and smooth view morph; the narrow fixed width and tiny close icon are limits.
title: Family Drawer
